ACYN.barrier_convention: Raw chart values are return coordinates relative to the initial strike date: e.g. 0.0 at initial level and -0.30 at a 30% decline. Keep the raw values; confirm payoff and level normalization before pricing.
ACYN.mark_to_market_convention: MarkToMarket is a premium/discount ratio in the chart, not a dollar market value. Do not substitute it for the three swap market values.
missing_inputs: Notional/weight of each of the 24 components and allocation across BNP/JPM/Citi swaps
Absolute initial fixing levels and complete observation, payment, call-protection and coupon-memory schedules
Funding spread, fees, settlement, accrued cash flows and collateral details
Same-date multi-index volatility surfaces, forwards/dividends, discount curves, correlations and cross-Greeks
ACYN.historical_source_conflict: March holdings and current November chart identify Russell 2000/RTY. The June financial statement writes Russell 1000 in its swap reference description; reconcile with actual confirmations rather than silently substituting either.
